“TRICK MASTER is huggable.” … … … … … … … …

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIn: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDe: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPo: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_Patricia: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…
I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIn: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPo: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaI: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaP: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIn: I ever so closely watched you coming!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDe: This outcome I didn't see coming…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPo:
Well, anyway, we both picked a weird place to get acquainted.
As one weirdo to another, let's do our best!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettP: I was hoping to switch places with you when I beat you, but…
